title: Ok but not great
text:
Ok but not great. First off this is a nice set for the money as far as looks goes. If you don't have kids or pets this would probably last you a long time. Just don't wash it very often or spot clean it. After a couple washes it gets lumpy! :/

This didn't hold up as well as I had hoped. We have 4 kids and pets so it did get put to the test. I washed it twice and the second washing it came out lumpy and uncomfortable. After laying flat on the bed for awhile it did get smoothed out a bit. Overall I'm not impressed. I replaced it with a chevron quilt comforter I found on Amazon. I find it better fits my needs. This one just didn't hold up well for me. And I bought it 6 months ago so it didn't last long either. It's microfiber which is fine but it seems like a cotton quilt or comforter does last longer wash after wash. I will stick to cotton from now on.
